_readme: Your own text, appended to the image prompt for that scene. Empty = default prompt only.

scenes: pov (every Sam/POV scene), bath, mishap (shower / walk-in), solo (a lady alone at max lust), duo (every shared scene with two ladies). Per-service wording now lives in services.json (image.extra).
clothing: how each clothing state is described. {outfit} and {underwear} are filled in from her wardrobe; commando becomes "bare skin, nothing underneath". nude falls back to partial while empty.
clothing.aside / aside_commando: used for Modest ladies during services, when her clothes are pulled aside instead of taken off.

expressions: face wording for how she's taking a service (bored / professional / into it / lost in it, plus flustered and smug from personalities.json → expr). Added to client images. expressionsByAct: per-service face wording added on top of the general one (filled with neutral defaults; edit freely, anything starting with TODO is skipped).

clothing.pubic: pubic hair wording ({hair} = her hair color; a lady's design.pubic replaces it). {pubic} can be used in any clothing line; it is also added on its own to services marked image.exposed in services.json when the clothing line doesn't mention it.

scenes.pov: first-person viewer perspective, intimate close framing, warm lantern light, soft shadows
scenes.bath: wet skin, water droplets, rising steam, warm glistening highlights
scenes.mishap: sudden candid moment, dramatic doorway lighting, caught off guard
scenes.solo: dim private bedroom, warm bedside candlelight, rumpled sheets, flushed skin
scenes.duo: two women close together, intertwined poses, warm intimate lighting

clothing.aside: still wearing {outfit}, clothes hiked up and pulled aside, {underwear} pushed aside to reveal {pubic}
